title: thai bourse operator list 28 foreign depository receipts investors seek global 2026 09 08
text:
Sept 8 (Reuters) - The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) said on Tuesday it would list 28 new ​depositary receipts linked to stocks and ETFs ‌from Asia, the U.S. and Europe, as the bourse races to match its Asian rivals in ​giving local investors easier access to ​global blue chips.
